# Source: Articulated Dragon

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Articulated Dragon
- **Artist / culture:** Myochin School Japanese, active late 19th century
- **Date:** c. 1880
- **Style:** Japanese (culture or style)
- **Classification:** iron
- **Department:** Arts of Asia
- **AIC artwork ID:** 129
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/129
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/24f95cb3-6020-6476-806e-dfd00e9c4369/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Prairie School

## Extracted source palette

`#D8D8D8, #383838, #B8B8B8, #686868, #989898, #584848, #181818, #888878`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#EFEFEF`
- `surface`: `#F9F9F9`
- `on_surface`: `#0F0F11`
- `primary`: `#584848`
- `on_primary`: `#F8F8F6`
- `secondary`: `#181818`
- `surface_variant`: `#D4D4D4`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#0F0F11`
- `outline`: `#B0B0B1`
- `error`: `#584848`
- `on_error`: `#F8F8F6`

- Font: `serif` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `12dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `16.65:1`, surface `18.19:1`
- Variant contrast: `12.92:1`
- Control contrast: `8.11:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
